senses.gloss:
Ūrmilā
------------------------------------------
If सीता is the very personification of ideal wifehood, ऊर्मिला is equally the ideal of wifely sacrifice. She too was the daughter of जनक and was married to लक्ष्मण. When लक्ष्मण chose to accompany राम to the forest on his banishment, ऊर्मिला who had to stay back at अयोध्या led an austere life until he returned.
Lakṣmaṇa had two sons—Aṅgada and Candraketu—from her. They were later crowned as the rulers of Kārupatha (in the northwest) and Candrakānta (in Mallabhūmi).
Ūrmilā is said to have committed सती after लक्ष्मण’s demise (vide रामायण, Uttarakāṇḍa, Chapter 102).
